name: RTSP Server Component
description: The `rtsp_server` component streams video from an [ESP32 Camera](https://esphome.io/components/esp32_camera/) over RTSP, the standard protocol used by video players and surveillance software. This allows tools like VLC, ffplay, go2rtc or Frigate to consume the camera feed directly, without any ESPHome-specific integration.

config_entries.label: Allowed Ips
config_entries.description: Only peers from these networks may connect; others are refused at accept time. Each entry is a single address (`192.168.1.50`) or an `address/prefix` network (`192.168.1.0/24`). When omitted, every host that can reach the port is accepted.

config_entries.label: Max Connections
config_entries.description: The maximum number of clients that can stream at the same time, from `1` to `4`. Each connection reserves about 900 bytes of memory and a socket for the whole run, so keep this low on memory-constrained boards. Defaults to `2`.

config_entries.label: Port
config_entries.description: The port the RTSP server listens on. Defaults to `554`, the standard RTSP port.
